I replied to Dana in her DM to confirm. Her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Brindle rollout is now Tuesdays at 14:30, as she asked.

I didn't save it again with gbrain's `remember` tool. The brain already stores her DM automatically and shows it only to her. A new `remember` entry might have been visible to other people, since I couldn't tell who sees those by default. Dana said no action was needed, so I left her calendar alone.
